name: Client Quality
description: Adds dashboard-managed rules that match a user, a client app, a device, or any combination, and either force the server to transcode playback for matching requests or cap their maximum streaming bitrate.
overview: Force transcoding or cap bitrate for specific users, client apps or devices.

versions.changelog: - Fix "Add rule" doing nothing on the settings page (dashboard createElement polyfill error).
- Fix the settings page dropdowns (user, client app, device) showing no options.
- Initial release: force-transcode and bitrate-cap rules by user, client and device.
